resources.string: Transfer profiles and IPTV settings using a password-encrypted file.
No document picker is installed. Browse accessible folders below, or install a document provider to access USB storage.
Invalid, damaged or unsupported backup. Nothing was changed.
Restore requires a signed-out app to avoid changing cloud data. Sign out before importing.
Unlock profile %1$s once before backup so its PIN can be preserved securely.
Use at least 12 characters. Keep this password: it cannot be recovered.
The operation failed. Check the file, storage space and access permissions.
The restore is ready. Restart to install it. An encrypted emergency backup is saved on this device using the same password.
This replaces local profiles, favorites, history and settings. IPTV and API keys are restored; sign in again to the main account and device-bound services. Confirm only after reviewing the profiles.
Local M3U files exceed the 16 MB backup limit. Use URL playlists or smaller files before exporting.
The restored configuration stays local until cloud sync is explicitly resumed.
Restart and resume synchronization with the signed-in account? Normal synchronization can update local and remote profiles and settings.
